# 299. Bulls and Cows

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def getHint(self, secret, guess):
        """
        :type secret: str
        :type guess: str
        :rtype: str
        """
        n = len(secret)
        d1, d2 = collections.defaultdict(int), collections.defaultdict(int)
        ans1, ans2 = 0, 0
        for i in range(n):
            if secret[i] == guess[i]:
                ans1 += 1
            else:
                d1[secret[i]] += 1
                d2[guess[i]] += 1
        for k in d1.keys():
            ans2 += min(d1[k], d2[k])
        return str(ans1) + "A" + str(ans2) + "B"
```
